title: Minimax Certified-Utility Regret for Policy Certificates under Curvature and Margin Conditions
banked_reason: D0.5 cold-tier score ceiling 5.2 < 7.4 field floor; the same-class uniformly vanishing O(r_n) upper bound remains open despite a math-panel PASS for the conditional converse.
gap_reasons: The promised matched minimax characterization with an observable rate-attaining exact-coverage rule is replaced by an explicitly open achievability question; the delivered result is only a conditional converse plus constant upper endpoints.

The bracket is honestly nonmatched, but its positioning does not give theorem-level comparisons to each named closest result (especially the cited off-policy/conformal, constrained-policy-tie, and calibration results) or explain precisely why none supplies this conditional lower-bound object.

The note proves a substantive three-mechanism all-procedure lower bound, but it does not characterize the minimax regret order: the only uniform upper bound is the nonvanishing constant tau, while r_n tends to zero.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery built and independently reviewed a conditional three-phase all-procedure regret lower bound, a global oracle identity, and an exact-validity result with a constant minimax upper endpoint. The matched frontier collapsed because the proposed split rule has no proved same-class uniformly vanishing regret bound: empirical near-tie budget-correspondence stability remains open. The final math panel passed, but the cold tier was incremental below the field floor; related-work comparisons also remain incomplete.
tldr: The oracle dual is global over all conditional coverage levels in \([0,1]\): capped generalized-inverse domination proves equality with the unrestricted causal policy-certificate target and makes the benchmark deficit nonnegative for every deployed certificate, while \(\mathcal T\) remains the local regularity interval. Under the disclosed fixed lower-catalog regime and \(\beta\nu<\min\{1,d\}\), the note proves the conditional all-procedure lower envelope from allocation, positive-gap action, and unequal-allocation exact-tie mechanisms. The allocation reduction now retains arbitrary certificate shortfall and controls its law-independent clipped inverse with a second-order \(O(s^6)\) remainder, leaving the \(s^4\) Assouad signal and all three rates unchanged. The observable split rule is exactly finite-sample valid with certificate-value loss at most \(2\), and a separate data-independent randomized fallback gives \(\mathfrak R_n\le\tau\); uniform vanishing achievability remains open.
gap: Zheng--Jin identify the policy-coupled population optimum and prove finite-sample validity, but give no utility-regret rate. Conditional-quantile estimation, margin classification, resource-boundary randomization, and off-policy conformal calibration are each available separately, yet none handles their common scalar multiplier and exact optimized-action ties.
fill: The project proves an exact Lagrangian regret decomposition, constructs a near-tie budget-bracketing selector with finite-sample policy-coupled coverage, derives its componentwise upper bound, and matches it with paired-bump, full-cube action, and two-law tie lower experiments on the same law class.
